OEPC eMobility

Charging, fleets, storage and battery exchange as one energy-service portfolio.

OEPC eMobility uses Ubiquiti 11 kW EV Station Lite and Pro hardware as the standard Level 2 charging layer, while Axiom manages energy, access, forecasting, DER, billing and settlement. DC fast charging and battery swapping remain partner-hardware categories.

01

OEPC Charge

Managed workplace, multifamily, municipal and destination Level 2 charging built around Ubiquiti EV Station Lite and Pro.

02

OEPC Fleet Energy

Depot charging, managed load, fleet scheduling, access control and energy optimization for commercial, government and defense fleets.

03

OEPC Charge+Storage

Charging paired with battery storage, solar and Axiom DER to reduce peaks and improve site economics.

04

OEPC Mobility Hub

Energy hubs combining charging, storage, telecom, retail services and future third-party DC fast charging.

05

OEPC Swap

Partner-based battery exchange for high-utilization fleets with Axiom forecasting, inventory, settlement and energy management.

AX

Axiom eMobility

Unified charge-point, fleet, storage and swap control with operating capacity, kWh delivered, revenue and asset-health telemetry.
